name: Nocturnal-Shoal
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past an exposed planetary core, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The ore-body estimates keep being revised upward, which keeps the gun-runner schedules full.
